notes.title: Support victims of war in Ukraine 🇺🇦
notes.content:
On 2.24.22, Russia started a horrible war in Ukraine.
We, the developers of PUSS!, as natives of Ukraine, stand against it.

We launch a special discount for PUSS!.
During the discount period and following March,
all the sales will be donated to the [b][url=https://redcross.org.ua/en/2022/02/donate-to-support-the-ukrainian-red-cross-to-help-civilians-in-this-difficult-time-for-ukraine/]Ukrainian Red Cross[/url][/b].

[i]The organisation provides first aid to all civilians in areas with a limited access to medical services.[/i]

If you want to support our country and us personally during these difficult times,
buy the game for yourself or as a gift to your friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/719750/PUSS

We will be grateful to everyone.

Peace ❤️

notes.content:
This Update brings two tweakable color filters: "[b]B/W[/b]" and "[b]HUE[/b]"

[previewyoutube=Y6XbBFaEOt0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]B/W[/b] [i]shrinks color value amplitude then makes it desaturated.[/i]
[b]HUE[/b] [i]shifts all screen colors.[/i]

You can switch between several [b]presets[/b] during the game:
[list]
[*] [b]【﻿Ｄｉｍ】[/b] [b](default)[/b]
limits the brightest values of the screen. Cares about your 👀 better than the rest.
For 'original colors' use "Null Null" preset;

[*] [b]【﻿Ｄｉｍ　ｗｉｔｈ　ｈｉｇｈｌｉｇｈｔｓ】[/b]
dims a screen but leaves the brightest values. Might help with better projectile tracking;

[*] [b]【﻿Ｈａｌｆ－Ｄｉｍ】[/b]

[*] [b]【﻿Ｎｕｌｌ　Ｎｕｌｌ】[/b] vanilla settings;

[*] [b]【﻿Ｍｏｎｏｃｈｒｏｍｅ】[/b]

[*] [b]【﻿Ｄｅｓａｔｕｒａｔｅｄ】[/b]

[*] [b]【﻿Ｒａｎｄｏｍ】[/b] randomizes screen colors on each pick;
[/list]

or find your personal favorite tuning and store it in a [b]【﻿Ｃｕｓｔｏｍ】[/b] slot.

[list]
[*] [b]🇪🇸 Spanish
[*] 🇮🇹 Italian

notes.content:
Hello!

We've got some news.

[h1]THE MAC VERSION OF PUSS! IS OUT![/h1]

Finally, it is out!
Linux users, we still need a little more time before releasing a Linux version, stay tuned for updates.

[h1]MAJOR BUGS FIXES IN V.1.087[/h1]

A new build, [b]1.087[/b] is out. We tried our best to fix the most critical bugs like softlocking, stucking on some boss levels, improper work of trigger buttons and some achievements issues.
If you still face the named above bugs, please tell us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/719750/discussions/2/1692659769948696750/]HERE[/url]

[h1]ALL OST DLC KEYS ARE NOW SENT[/h1]

We finally sent all 10000 OST DLC keys! Please, check your inbox.

[h1]TRADING CARDS[/h1]

You often ask where are PUSS! trading cards.
The answer is they are all made and waiting to be released by Steam. PUSS! needs a little more time before Steam will allow to release cards. Spreading the word about the game should probably speed up this process.

notes.title: A LITTLE MORE PATIENCE (PLEASE)
notes.content:
Hello,

Ivan from teamCOIL here.

Game development is a journey full of challenges and hard decisions. The case of PUSS! is not an exception and there's another hard decision we have to make. When I [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/719750/announcements/detail/1649881910404104150]posted[/url] news about delaying the game’s release two months ago, its production was freezed. Our developer had to leave the team because of personal reasons. We’d spent a lot of time finding a replacement and luckily we did.

But we’ve lost that time and still have a work to do to finish PUSS!. We're at the finish line, but can't let you down by releasing an unpolished game. It’s that situation when you have to choose the lesser of two evils.

[b]PUSS! will be released on August 2.[/b]

I hope you'll understand this decision, it was hard to make.

Thank you for your patience,

Ivan
